Cua Driver shows you when an agent is driving your Mac through [cua-driver](https://github.com/trycua/cua), and gives you a few ways to stop it. This is the first release on GitHub.

## What's new in 1.1.0

- ⌃⌥⌘⎋ stops every agent from any app, even with the shelf closed. You can rebind it on Droppy's Shortcuts page, and a card on the notch tells you how many agents it stopped.
- When an agent starts driving, a card drops out of the notch with its name. Agents that were already running when Droppy started, or while the Mac slept, don't get one. You can turn it off in Settings.
- Cua Driver has a page in Settings. It shows whether the driver is running, its version, its permission mode, and whether it has Accessibility and Screen Recording, with the command to fix any that are missing.
- An agent that pauses to think no longer makes the notch flicker. It counts as driving for 30 seconds after its last action, and you can set that anywhere from 15 seconds to 2 minutes.
- The notch shows a record mark while the driving agent records the screen.
- Each session's row says when it started and whether it's recording, and rows stay put instead of reordering as agents act.
- The widget warns you when the driver runs in unrestricted mode, where agents act without asking.
- After Stop every agent, cua-driver blocks new agents until it restarts. The widget now says agents are blocked instead of mistaking it for missing permissions, and Settings shows the restart command.
- Scripts and Shortcuts can stop every agent by opening `droppy://droplet/cuadriver/stop`.

The full history is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/NathanGlasby/cua-driver-droplet/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install

1. Download `Cuadriver-1.1.0.droplet.zip` below and unzip it.
2. In Droppy, open Settings › Store › Local droplets, add `Cuadriver.droplet` and approve it.

You need Droppy 15.3 or later and cua-driver running on the same Mac (`cua-driver serve`). The build isn't signed by Droppy yet, so Droppy asks you to approve it each time it opens. [Droppy Playground](https://getdroppy.app/download/playground) loads it without asking.

The zip's SHA-256 is in `Cuadriver-1.1.0.droplet.zip.sha256`.
